title: Regional distribution of blood via electrical impedance tomography
summary: Electrical impedance tomography is a procedure to show regional changes of the electrical resistance in the tissue within the image plane. In healthy subjects and in three patient groups it will be investigated if the EIT signal from the abdomen allows insights into regional information about blood perfusion in the abdomen.
conditions: Healths subjects, patients under surgery,patients receiving stenting of the kidney arteries, patients under post-surgical intensive care monitoring

interventions.name:
In 24 healthy subjects EIT recordings will be performed with different positions of the EIT-electrode belt and extended hemodynamic monitoring applied. Further, the positions of the abdominal organs will be determined via ultrasound measurements and MRI.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Healthy subject: ASA 1
Patients during surgery: Surgery duration >3 h, ASA ≤ 3
Patients with angioplasty: planned angioplasty, ASA <3
Postoperative critical care patients:  Postoperative critical care monitoring, ASA ≤ 4

(ASA = patient risk classification of the American Society of Anesthesiologists)
Exclusion criteria:
No ability to gain informed consent for any reason, age < 18 y, age > 84 y, pregnancy, active implants, skin problems in the area of the electrode belt or in the position for planned US-scan, surgery or sterilization area conflict with position of the EIT belt.
